_comment: Maps each of the 30 campaign articles to a real, existing Bakudan photo (Bakudan Photo/ directory) used as the source for a cropped 1200x630 WebP hero via scripts/campaign/build_images.py. No image is reused more than once. All source photos are real Bakudan dish/brand photography, not stock or generated art.
